name: Watch and Whisper
summary: Your voice is your only weapon. Watch and Whisper is an intense, microphone-based surveillance horror game. Bound to a room with a cracking, cursed mirror, you must gaze into the Magical Ball to monitor your surroundings for paranormal anomalies. To survive, you must spot the changes, draw precise arcane sigils, and whisper actual incantations into your real-life microphone to banish the entities. Keep the mirror sealed until your ritual is complete, then prepare to face the lurking demon head-on!
